items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And with Lester Lanin and Meyer Davis and them, going out on gigs

ctx.x: Now we'll go back to how when we come back from Europe things were bad, and so now Lips Page and all those guys are playing, so Lips said, "I know all about that ______. I was there. I know all about France, so don't stand there and look at us. Just get your horn and come up here on this truck and get this 12.50 right along with us." (Laughter). You know how Lips is. He's crazy. And there we go and play to 145th Street, and then we'd go down to 135th Street and they would go

in front of the Theresa, you know. So I just couldn't get with it right away, you know. I had to wait. I knew I had to come in sooner or later, but I had to wait. So while I'm thinking about it, I get this contact down there with this lady in Rochester. That was nice. Paid your way down on the train, three days and back, you know, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. And that was -- kind of helped you a little bit. And with Lester Lanin and Meyer Davis and them, going out on gigs, and now I'm looking at this paper they…
